notes: Fix: the time-to-target estimate never once produced a date. Your trend was fitted against milliseconds instead of days, so every target read as over a year away

New: every exercise now carries an effort weight. A weighted incline crunch is worth more than a flat one, a machine press less than a barbell press, a compound more than an isolation, and a hard range of motion more than a short one. Derived from the movement itself, so it works for all 930 exercises with nothing to enter, and you can override any of them
Fix: a session exactly 7, 14, 21 or 28 days ago was counted in TWO weeks at once, which inflated the volume chart, the month-on-month changes and the fatigue read

Fix: cardio was scored on minutes alone, so a 30 minute stroll scored the same as a 30 minute threshold run and your logged distance was thrown away. Distance now counts, against each sport own scale, and your pace is reported
Fix: bodyweight and timed exercises such as push-ups and planks had no trend value at all, so they could never show a time-to-target and could never be flagged as stalled
Fix: past the maximum useful volume the muscle score kept climbing, so overtraining a group scored higher than training it correctly
Fix: your level could go DOWN. Experience was paid for your current streak rather than your best one, so missing a day could drop a level
Fix: one improvement was counted as three personal records, because reps, volume and tonnage all rise together
Fix: tonnage invented a rep count on weighted carries and timed holds, adding weight you never lifted to your totals and badges
Fix: the advice said Add minus four sets a week. The tilde rendered as a minus sign in the pixel font
Fix: the year chart months could repeat or overlap, which happened on the 29th to the 31st
Fix: the quads versus hamstrings check used your entire history while every number beside it used the last 28 days
